reviews.text: What a pleasure to do business with qualified,experienced and the friendliest people ever!!Awesome meeting you guys!

reviews.text: No response at all… business must be good if they don’t feel the need to contact clients

messagesToArno.context: Messages published by Lusso from clients when Arno left Scuderia (Ferrari) to found Lusso. No names are published, so none are shown.
items: You are the only reason I have stayed with Ferrari over the years. You treat each of your clients like a friend with impeccable service.
